**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into on [●], 20[●] (the "Effective Date"),

**BETWEEN**  
[Employer Name], a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [Employer Address], Punjab (hereinafter referred to as the "Employer"),  

**AND**  
[Employee Full Name], residing at [Employee Address], Punjab (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").  

The Employer and the Employee are collectively referred to as the "Parties" and individually as a "Party".

---

### 1. **APPOINTMENT**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee, and the Employee hereby accepts appointment, as a Data Scientist, effective from [Start Date], subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

---

### 2. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to the role of a Data Scientist, including but not limited to:  
- Designing and implementing machine learning models;  
- Analyzing large and complex datasets to extract insights;  
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate data solutions;  
- Preparing reports, dashboards, and presentations for stakeholders;  
- Ensuring data integrity, security, and compliance with applicable standards.  

The Employee shall report to the designated supervisor or manager and shall perform such other lawful duties consistent with the role as may be assigned from time to time by the Employer.

---

### 3. **WORKPLACE**  
The Employee’s primary workplace shall be the Employer’s office located in [City], Punjab. The Employee shall work under a **hybrid work arrangement**, which may include working from the Employer’s office and remotely from an approved location, subject to operational requirements and the Employer’s internal policies. The Employee shall be required to report to the office as reasonably directed by the Employer.

---

### 4. **SALARY AND COMPENSATION**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 1,775,000 (Indian Rupees Seventeen Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll practices. This salary is exclusive of any statutory deductions and subject to applicable income tax laws.  

No additional compensation, bonuses, or allowances are guaranteed under this Agreement unless separately approved in writing by the Employer.

---

### 5. **PROBATION PERIOD**  
The Employee shall serve a probation period of **six (6) months** from the date of joining. During this period, the performance of the Employee shall be evaluated. The Employer reserves the right to terminate the employment during probation with **thirty (30) days’ prior written notice** or pay in lieu thereof. Upon successful completion of the probation period, the Employee’s position shall be confirmed in writing by the Employer.

---

### 6. **WORKING TIME**  
The Employee shall work **forty-two (42) scheduled hours per week**, distributed over five (5) working days, subject to the Employer’s operational needs. The standard working hours shall be as per the Employer’s internal schedule. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to fulfill job responsibilities, in accordance with applicable labor laws.

---

### 7. **LEAVE**  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave benefits in accordance with the applicable provisions of the **Punjab State Shops and Establishments Act** and other relevant statutory regulations, including:  
- Earned Leave  
- Sick Leave  
- Casual Leave  
- Public Holidays  

Leave entitlements shall accrue in accordance with the Employer’s leave policy, which is subject to change in compliance with applicable law.

---

### 8. **STATUTORY BENEFITS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under applicable Indian laws, including but not limited to:  
- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS), as per the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952;  
- Employee State Insurance (ESI), if applicable under the Employees’ State Insurance Act, 1948;  
- Gratuity, under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service;  
- Any other statutory benefits mandated by central or state legislation.  

The Employer shall deduct and contribute such amounts as required by law.

---

### 9. **CONFIDENTIALITY**  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use for any personal purpose any confidential information, trade secrets, business strategies, technical data, or proprietary information of the Employer, except as required in the course of authorized duties. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment and shall be subject to applicable law.

---

### 10. **WORK-RELATED INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**  
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software, algorithms, models, reports, documentation, and inventions, created by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the Employer’s business ("Work Product"), shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee agrees to assign, and hereby assigns, all rights, title, and interest in such Work Product to the Employer. This provision is subject to applicable intellectual property laws in India.

---

### 11. **WORKPLACE POLICIES**  
The Employee shall comply with all current and future workplace policies, codes of conduct, data security protocols, and HR guidelines issued by the Employer, including those related to data protection, remote work, and ethical standards. The Employee acknowledges receipt or access to the Employer’s employee handbook and internal policies.

---

### 12. **TERMINATION**  
Either Party may terminate this Agreement by providing **thirty (30) days’ prior written notice** to the other Party. During the notice period, the Employee shall continue to perform duties unless otherwise directed. The Employer reserves the right to require the Employee to remain away from the workplace during the notice period without prejudice to salary and benefits ("garden leave"), subject to applicable law.  

Termination during probation shall follow the terms in Clause 5. Upon termination, the Employee shall return all company property, documents, and access credentials.

---

### 13. **DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the **exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in [City], Punjab**. The Parties agree to first attempt to resolve disputes amicably through internal grievance mechanisms, if available, before initiating legal proceedings. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

---

### 14. **MISCELLANEOUS**  
- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions or agreements.  
- Amendments must be in writing and signed by both Parties.  
- If any provision is found invalid, the remainder shall remain in full force.  
- The Employee acknowledges that this Agreement is subject to applicable labor and employment laws in India, including any amendments thereto.

---

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this Agreement on the date first above written.

**For [Employer Name]**  
Signature: _________________________  
Name: [Authorized Signatory Name]  
Title: [Designation]  
Date: [●], 20[●]  

**Employee**  
Signature: _________________________  
Name: [Employee Full Name]  
Date: [●], 20[●]  

---
